name: qa-db-migrations
description: Database migration testing for Flyway, Liquibase and Atlas: classify every schema change by risk and review blast radius and locking before it ships. Sorts DDL and DML into an eight-category operation taxonomy. A review agent (migration-blast-radius-reviewer) covers blast radius plus DDL performance: CONCURRENTLY index builds, ACCESS EXCLUSIVE rewrites, post-migration ANALYZE, and lock-time estimates.
